description.en: Server-side image generation that calls Volcengine Ark Seedream directly, with no client UI: 1024 to 2048 sizes, reference images (image-to-image) and a six-part prompt shape. Keywords: image generation, text-to-image, image-to-image, Seedream. MIT.
description.zh: 服务端生图：直连火山方舟 Seedream，无客户端 UI；支持 1024~2048 尺寸、参考图（图生图）与六段式提示词。关键词：生图 image、文生图、图生图、Seedream、豆包。MIT。
